name: Ambrosio de Funes Villalpando
role: Spanish captain general of Cuba; viceroy of Navarra 1765-1768
contribution: A captain general of Cuba, from July 1763 to June 1765.

checks.lead: Ambrosio de Funes Villalpando (1720 - 15 July 1782), was a captain general of Cuba, from July 1763 to June 1765. Prior to that, he had represented Spain at the court of the Russian Empire.
